UPDATE: Fake Gynae HSPCA Sentencing

By: Anna-Maria van Niekerk | Paid

Proposal


Show:

Unique Selling Point:
UPDATING THE VERDICT/SENTENCING of the HSPCA: SCRIPT

VO: We first met Dr Anil Anirudhra in Cape Town in 2013, where he was practising as a gynaecologist. That’s despite the good doctor only being registered as a GP. As a gynae, he misdiagnosed patients and misread ultrasounds … but that wasn’t the worst of it… He was caught – on camera - making sexually suggestive comments while examining a patient.

00:45 ANIL: Have you ever had an Indian guy? NO!

VO: Surprisingly, by that time Dr Anirudhra had already been convicted of fraud, erased from the South African Medical Register and struck from the UK’s Medical Register for serious professional misconduct. Yet, he’d had been allowed to re-register by the Health Professions Council of South Africa on probation.

01:19 – 01:26 JOHN: Are you a gynae? ANIL: I’m not registered as one at the moment. JOHN: Why does it say gynae on your door?


Summary:
...script continues..

VO: After our broadcast, the HPCSA acted against him but by 2019 he was back on their roll. This time, he did register as a gynaecologist and changed his name to Dr Ramdhin.

02:51 – 03:02 NANDI: In April I had to see the doctor because I was feeling some pain, abnormal pain, so I went to Dr Ramdin. The doctor suspected that I’ve got fibroids.

VO: In 2020 we spoke to a patient of Dr Ramdhin’s we’ll call Nandi who had cervical cancer. We also spoke to the daughter of Beauty Mama, diagnosed with ovarian cancer. Astonishingly, against all treatment protocols, Dr Ramdhin operated on both women.

6:18 – 6:31 NANDI: I heard the doctors talking saying this is a mess. There was puss and the nurses were calling the doctor, and the doctor was nowhere to be found.

VO: Nandi wasn't alone; Beauty Mama’s daughter would later describe how her mom also suffered after her surgery.

11:20 – 11:34 DAUGHTER: We did the surgery on your mom, but it doesn’t look good and I asked him, what do you mean, it doesn’t look good? And he said it’s better you see for yourself…

VO: Within months of their surgeries, both women were dead. After being reported to the HPCSA, Dr Ramdin this week pleaded guilty to serious professional misconduct and was suspended for 12 months. He will then be on probation for two years. He’s also facing a pending criminal case. Questions, though...are being asked... as to whether Dr Ramndin’s long history of serious misconduct should mean him ever being allowed to practice again.
